name: tor-event-calendar-ai
description: Manage a connected private calendar through an explicitly invoked skill and shared local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Manage your calendar from your local AI workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect a verified calendar account once through the browser, then manage events, drafts and files using natural language. Supports account-scoped local CLI connections and platform-specific planning. Social publication needs a separately verified publisher; no cloud MCP connector is included.
defaultPrompt: Use tor-event-calendar to show today's events in my connected account.
Use tor-event-calendar to create a project meeting tomorrow at 09:30 in Europe/Kyiv.
Use tor-event-calendar to prepare a Reddit draft and ask for missing content.
